settings.heading: Meet the clinicians behind the care
settings.subheading: Licensed clinicians with advanced training in trauma-based practice. Each member of our team brings a distinct specialty and a shared commitment to attuned, evidence-based care.

settings.name: Dr. Angela (Niki) Serravalle
settings.bio_short: Licensed psychologist, EMDR Certified Therapist and Approved Consultant, and founder of Center for Balanced Living. Specializing in trauma, psychological evaluation, and professional training.

settings.name: Amanda Foxwell
settings.bio_short: EMDR-trained therapist specializing in trauma and anxiety for teens and adults. Holistic and nature-based approach. Accepting new clients.

settings.name: Kirsten Lowe
settings.bio_short: Trauma-based therapist specializing in CBT, goal-focused therapy, and accountability. Accepting new clients.
